text:
**Best all-around kit for van life: [BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200W solar panel](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2-200w-solar-kit).** It has a 2,073.6Wh battery—useful for a fridge, laptop, and other essentials—and the panel is included. The listed price is $1,199 before the page’s mentioned discount; the kit’s car-socket charging is only about 96W, so don’t expect it to recharge quickly while driving. ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/best-solar-generator-kit-for-van-life))

If **low weight matters more than extra capacity**, consider the **[Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2](https://powersized.com/best/rv/)** instead: it weighs 24.9 lb and supports up to 600W solar input, but has about half the battery capacity at 1,024Wh. ([PowerSized](https://powersized.com/best/rv/))

**Bottom line:** I’d pick the BLUETTI for longer stays and more stored power; the Anker for a lighter, more compact setup.

judge.top_pick: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W Solar Panel Kit
